text:
ana: Heads-up — npm audit flagged a high severity transitive CVE in postcss used by our console-ui build. see dependabot PR below :warning:

mike: link? I only saw the shrinkwrap churn last week.

ana: https://github.com/redwood/console-ui/pull/987 (dependabot) — vuln in postcss 8.x -> requires patch to postcss-safe-parser or bump of upstream package. audit suggests 8.4.7+.

kevin: Does this affect runtime code or only devtooling (css-loader/postcss pipeline)?

liz: It's in the build pipeline — postcss is used in CRA-like pipeline. However one of the postcss plugins is a transitive dep of our design-system; could be in prod bundles if we ship processed CSS.

mike: TL;DR — exploitable only if user-supplied CSS gets processed at runtime. Our server-side build runs at CI, no runtime processing. Risk is low for direct RCE but still should patch.

ana: Agreed. Proposal: prioritize as P2 (security team) but auto-merge the patch PR after CI & test pass. Want to avoid long lockfile churn.

kevin: What's the lockfile impact? last time pnpm/yarn caused huge diffs.

liz: This repo uses pnpm workspace now. Dependabot PR updates lockfile and bumps a few unrelated transitive versions — diff is ~700 lines. Not great but acceptable.

ci-bot: CI report: lint ✔, unit tests ✔, integration tests failing (css snapshot mismatch) — @mike @liz

mike: snapshot failure expected — postcss patch changes output formatting. I'll run update-snap and verify visual diffs.

ana: Can we do minimal change: add package override in package.json to pin safe parser to patched version instead of full dependency bump? That would reduce churn.

kevin: We can try "overrides" block in pnpm to pin postcss-safe-parser@8.4.7. But confirm that resolves the vuln shown by npm audit.

liz: If overrides work, we still need to run full CI and update snapshots. Also check our CDN cache invalidation plans if CSS output changes slightly.

mike: I'll test overrides locally. If snapshots only have whitespace diffs, we'll accept and update. If visual regressions, escalate.

dependabot: Automated security update created: bump postcss and dependent-lockfile.

ana: Timeline/owners — mike to try override and run snapshots today (ETA 2h). kevin to validate npm audit report and confirm vulnerability metadata (CVE IDs). liz to prepare small rollback plan for UI assets if visuals break. Security to auto-merge after green CI.

kevin: CVE-2024-XXXX mapped to postcss-safe-parser <8.4.7, exploitability: low (no direct server-side eval), CVSS 6.1. I'll add notes to the vuln tracker.

mike: local test: overrides fixed the vuln in npm audit, snapshots only whitespace diffs. Pushing updated snapshots to PR.

liz: Reviewed visual diffs in storybook — unchanged. Good to merge.

ana: Great. Quick postmortem: add a short docs note about build-time-only vs runtime deps and make an alert for postcss family in our dependency monitor.

ci-bot: PR merged by automation after required checks passed. :tada:

ana: Thanks everyone. Follow-up: kevin, please add the CVE entry to the quarterly compliance report.

kevin: Will do.

ana: Closing thread.
